title: Shaame gareebaa'n me
body:
Shaame ghareeba'n me zainab pukari..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
kis kisko rou'n mai ghum ki maari
<<MINI>>
Shaame ghareeba'n me zainab pukari..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Bachho se kehti thi zehra ki pyaari..(2)
Mai tum pe sadqe mai tumpe waari
<<MINI>>
Shaame ghareeba'n me zainab pukari..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Har simt laashe bikhre pade hai
khaime haram ke sab jal chuke hai
bachhe hamare sehme huwe hai
godi mein maao'n ki baithe huwe hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa yateemo pe hai khauf taari
2. Maare gaye hai maqtal mein saare
bhai bhatije bete dulaare
abbas sote hai darya kanare
<<DIVIDER>>
khushiya manate hai qatil hamare..(2)
baba ab aao madad ko hamari
3. Zulmo sitam se aakar bachao
abbas o qasim akbar kaha ho
<<DIVIDER>>
ehle haram ko aakar sambhalo
tatbeer bekas ko koi batao..(2)
bewaein karti hai sab aaho zaari
4. Cheeni ridaein asbaab loota
<<DIVIDER>>
abid ka mere bistar bhi cheena
baali sakina ne khaya tamacha
badal masaeb ka sar par hai chaya..(2)
ujda hai gulshan maa ka hamari
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kaise yateemo ko ab mai sambhalu
ranjo mahan se kaise nikalu
kisko pukaru kis samt jaau
bhai se waada kaise nibhau..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
chalti hai dil par ek ghum ki aandhi
6. Sawan ye nauha jo tune likha hai
qissa nahi hai aisa huwa hai
ranjo alam ka daftar khula hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ummul masaeb ke dil ki sadaa hai..(2)
khaate nahi hai kuch rahm naari
<<MINI>>
Shaame ghareeba'n me zainab pukari..(2)
